known_issues: Publishing content fails every time the user tries (cannot publish).

existing_features.title: Improve error handling in the Publish Content page so that when publishing fails, the UI shows the actual backend error message (when available) instead of always showing a generic failure message.

Ensure that a successfully published submission becomes visible in the article feeds immediately after publishing (Home/News queries refresh appropriately) and that the success state is only shown after the publish mutation truly succeeds.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix the backend authorization logic so authenticated Internet Identity users can successfully publish content via the existing `uploadArticle(article)` method, while still preventing anonymous callers from publishing.

projectName: Fix publish flow failing on every content submission
